consigna: Three separate recordings, one per day, two to three minutes each. Each one isolates two skills from the last eight weeks. Planning in notes is allowed; a text read aloud does not count.
requisitos: Recording 1: softening an opinion (week 4) + reporting what someone said (week 5)
Recording 2: persuading and negotiating (week 7) + second conditionals (week 6)
Recording 3: regrets with modal perfect and third conditional (week 8) + switching register (week 9)
No recording longer than three minutes
A different topic in each recording
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Recording 1: give honest but softened feedback on something, reporting what someone else said about it.
*Wed (10 min).* Recording 2: persuade someone to change a plan, using two conditional offers.
*Fri (10 min).* Recording 3: talk about a decision you regret, first informally, then in a formal register.
autochequeo: Are all six skills present, each in its own recording?
Did I speak, or read a script?
Did the backshift survive when I was speaking?
Did one recording repeat another in content?
Which of the three was weakest, and why?
promptCorreccion: These are three separate short productions with two skills each. (1) For each, say whether both skills are present and well done. (2) Tell me which recording is weakest and why. (3) For that one, give me a sentence carrying both skills at once. Correct nothing outside these six points. ---
